```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(modelsummary)
library(sjPlot)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
cep <- read_excel("base_91.xlsx")
```

```{r}
head(cep)
names(cep)
```


```{r}

cep <- cep %>%
  mutate(
    confianza_evang = factor(confianza_6_b, 
                             levels = c(4, 3, 2, 1), 
                             labels = c("Nada", "Poca", "Bastante", "Mucha"), 
                             ordered = TRUE),
    
    narco_bin = case_when(
      seguridad_45 == 2 ~ 0,
      seguridad_45 == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Sí")),
    
    narco_3cat = factor(seguridad_45, 
                        levels = c(2, 1, -8), 
                        labels = c("No", "Sí", "No sabe")),
    
    religion_cat = case_when(
      religion_82 == 1 ~ "Católica",
      religion_82 == 2 ~ "Evangélica",
      religion_82 %in% 3:8 ~ "Otra religión",
      religion_82 %in% 9:11 ~ "Sin religión/Ateo/Agnóstico",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Católica", "Evangélica", "Otra religión", "Sin religión/Ateo/Agnóstico")),
    
    edad_limpia = ifelse(edad < 0, NA, edad),
    sexo_cat = factor(sexo, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Hombre", "Mujer")),
    educ_cat = case_when(
      esc_nivel_1_c %in% 0:2 ~ "Básica o menos",
      esc_nivel_1_c %in% 3:4 ~ "Media",
      esc_nivel_1_c %in% 5:10 ~ "Superior",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Básica o menos", "Media", "Superior")),
    
    zona_cat = factor(zona_u_r, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Urbana", "Rural"))
  )

```

```{r}
cep <- cep %>%
  select(confianza_evang, narco_bin, narco_3cat, 
         religion_cat, edad_limpia, sexo_cat, 
         educ_cat, zona_cat, pond, estrato, secu)
```

```{r}
cep <- cep %>%
  select(confianza_evang, narco_bin, narco_3cat, 
         religion_cat, edad_limpia, sexo_cat, 
         educ_cat, zona_cat)
```
